title: 37 McKee Avenue, Finglas, Dublin 11
description:
RAY COOKE AUCTIONEERS are delighted to present No. 37 McKee Avenue, a superb four bedroom extended mid-terrace bungalow ideally positioned within this highly sought-after residential location in Finglas East.

 

Situated on McKee Avenue, this spacious family home comes to the market in great condition throughout and boasts a large rear extension, converted attic, gas-fired central heating and rear vehicular access. The property offers well-proportioned accommodation throughout and is sure to appeal to first-time buyers, growing families and those looking to downsize alike.

 

The accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hallway leading to a double bedroom, bright and spacious living room, single bedroom with built-in wardrobes, further single bedroom, double bedroom and main family bathroom. The hallway continues through to a bright and spacious open-plan kitchen/dining area, with the kitchen providing access to a separate utility room. The kitchen further opens into a large rear extension currently used as a sunroom, creating an excellent additional living space and providing direct access to the fully paved rear garden.

 

The property further benefits from a converted attic, offering excellent additional space and versatility, while externally there is a front garden and a fully paved rear garden with rear access suitable for vehicle access. No. 37 also benefits from gas-fired central heating, double-glazed windows and c. 117 sq.m of accommodation.

 

McKee Avenue enjoys an excellent and highly convenient location close to Finglas Village and a host of local amenities. Residents are within easy reach of numerous shops, cafés, restaurants, public houses, supermarkets, schools, sports clubs and recreational facilities. The area also benefits from excellent transport links, with numerous Dublin Bus right outside the property providing regular services to Dublin City Centre and surrounding areas. The M50 and M2 motorways are also within easy reach, providing ease of access to Dublin Airport, Dublin City Centre and all major national routes.

 

This property offers a fantastic combination of generous living accommodation, excellent extension space and a highly convenient location. Viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the size and potential of this superb home.

 

Contact Ray Cooke Auctioneers today on 0861985247 or 015411455 to arrange a viewing or register your interest.
